title: Report-rendering CPU incident with join-once serialization repair

task.summary: Triage a report-rendering CPU incident and remove the quadratic string-building hotspot.
task.instructions: Use the incident clues to localize the super-linear hotspot in the document serializer, apply a performance repair, and keep every rendering test green including the exact-output guards.
task.acceptance_notes: Both the ops and code requirements must pass; the renderer must build a document whose cost grows linearly with the number of records, with byte-for-byte identical output.

visible_context.issue_text: On-call opened an incident after the window-reporter workers saturated CPU and lagged whenever a reporting window contained many records. Render time grows super-linearly: doubling the number of records in a window roughly quadruples the time spent building the report document, even though the records themselves are cheap to format.
error_logs: alerts/reporter_cpu.log: time to render a window grows faster than the record count; doubling the records ~4x the render time
profile: a single document-building step dominates the flame graph, its cost rising with the square of the output size; samples cluster in string allocation and memory copies
reproduction_steps: Inspect the report-render fixture and run the unit tests.
Use the profile clues to localize the super-linear hotspot before applying a code fix.
visible_context.notes: The incident points at how the worker assembles the output document from per-record lines, not at the cost of formatting any single line.

ops_fault.description: Synthetic report-rendering CPU incident tied to the report_render_quadratic fixture.
detection_keywords: render time grows super-linearly with record count
doubling the records quadruples the work
localization_keywords: quadratic hotspot in the document-building path
output assembled by repeated accumulation inside a loop
cost grows with the square of the output size
time dominated by string allocation and memory copies
repair_keywords: collect the pieces and join them once
accumulate parts in a list then build the result in a single pass
avoid rebuilding the whole accumulator on every iteration
replace the repeated concatenation with a one-shot join
stream the pieces into a single buffer
make output assembly linear in the output size

code_fault.description: The report serializer assembles the output document by repeatedly concatenating onto a growing string inside a loop, recopying the whole accumulated prefix every iteration, making rendering O(n^2) in the output size instead of O(n).

constraints.notes: This task expects incident localization followed by a performance fix that replaces a quadratic repeated string concatenation with a single linear-time join.

notes: Combined report-rendering CPU incident and join-once serialization repair task.
